summary: George Russell won the Las Vegas Grand Prix from pole position, 7.3s ahead of Lewis Hamilton, with Carlos Sainz completing the podium.
Lewis Hamilton made the biggest climb, from P10 to P2.
Esteban Ocon had a day to forget, dropping from P11 to P17.
The stewards penalised PIA (5 second time penalty).
There were 39 pit stops in total; the winner stopped 2 times.
Max Verstappen leads the championship by 63 points over Lando Norris.
